name: Emerald Fisher
source:
Awwww Emerald, she's a bit special isn't she! She can usually be found daydreaming in the woods outside school, painting and talking to fairies! The question is... are her tales of fairy kingdom based on fact or idle fantasy?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
